sources.title: Veyra — Two AIs. One window.
sources.snippet: Two AIs. One window. A tiling terminal manager for AI coding agents. Run Claude Code, Codex CLI, and shells side-by-side in tiled panes. Pro cuts your token usage by roughly 30-50% with output trimming, smart caching, and six task modes.

sources.title: veyra-ai (Veyra AI) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Tiny English language models, fast CPU inference, function calling, tool use, Python-focused small models, distillation, RLVR, and local AI.

sources.title: PDF Veyra: A Post-Super-Intelligence Interplanetary LLM System
sources.snippet: Abstract—Veyra is a vertically integrated large language model (LLM) platform designed for post-super-intelligence (post-SI) operation in multi-planetary deployment contexts. This paper presents the system architecture addressing fundamental limi-tations of current LLM systems architected for single-planet, human-timescale, culturally homogeneous deployment. sources.title: Veyra — Prediction Intelligence Layer
sources.snippet: The Intelligence Layer for Prediction Markets Veyra turns fragmented signals — news, social sentiment, on-chain flows and market odds — into ranked, high-conviction probability scores. The Bloomberg Terminal for Polymarket, Kalshi and beyond.
